en.topic_title: All 15 Hong Kong tour groups in Kyushu safe after 7.1-magnitude earthquake in Japan’s Kumamoto
en.topic_summary:
All 15 tour groups in Kyushu, Japan, are safe after a strong earthquake rocked the island and killed at least a dozen people, the Travel Industry Council of Hong Kong (HKTIC) has said.



A general view shows damage to part of the Aeon Mall Kumamoto in Kashima, Kumamoto Prefecture, on July 29, 2026, after an earthquake struck southwestern Japan on July 28, 2026. Photo: Philip Fong/AFP.
